name: muonsystem
note: Module: the muon system in Ember's own NanoAOD of a reconstruction file (Phase 2 and Run 3; phase2.json and run3.json include it, and declare its domain Muons). The release's DPGAnalysis/MuonTools tables: DT 4D, CSC and GEM segments, drawn as lines of 25 cm (about a chamber's depth) centred on their global position, along their global direction; GEM and RPC rechits as markers at their global position. Each detector is a layer of its own colour (the Muons part is coloured by layer). GE0 (GEM station 0, behind HGCal in Phase 2) is mostly neutron background: its rechits are filtered out by default (filter 'station != 0'). Tables are in collection order (by DetId), so that index columns of other tables address them. Truth: no muon-segment associator in CMSSW (truth-graph.md gap 17), and no truth table of muon hits (the truth graph's muon channel is keyed by detector unit, not by cell: gap 16).
